mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Conditions are clear at Verona Community Park, and we are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon. If you are looking to the skies, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 5:01 PM, rising over Cross Plains and moving toward Madison near the Home Depot, staying low on the horizon.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Additionally, refuse and recycling collection will be delayed to Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed for the holiday.

We have plenty of local entertainment this week! Live music is happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, with more live performances scheduled for tomorrow at Paddy Mac's. Plus, keep an eye out for yoga at Insight Wellness on November 23.
Looking at recent reports, on November 6, officers responded to a business in the 500 block of West Verona Avenue where a driver was found passed out. The driver was ultimately arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so make sure to stop by today to grab a scoop.
